# 04 Let a timeline name a message, block or box grouping

## Outcome

Every element `renderSequenceToSVG` tags is addressable: a timeline can name a message
(`Shopper-Web`, `Web-Payments#2`), a control-flow block (`loop:1`, `alt:2`) or a box grouping
(`box:1`), alongside the participants ticket 03 delivered.

## Why this ticket exists

Ticket 03 restricted the valid-id set to participants so the pipeline could be proved end to end on
the ADR-0009 case. The remaining three kinds of id are already assigned by `buildSequenceModel` and
already stamped into the SVG by `renderSequenceToSVG` — the only thing stopping an author from
naming them is which ids go into the set handed to `resolveTimeline`.

Collecting them is not a one-liner: blocks nest to any depth and messages live inside branch
bodies, so the set comes from a recursive walk of the resolved statement tree, not from a flat list.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The valid-target-id set is participants + boxes + every message id + every block id,
      collected by walking `ResolvedSequenceStatement` recursively through block branches.
- [x] A message inside a nested block (`loop` > `alt` > message) is addressable by its id — assert
      at depth, not just at top level.
- [x] `enter box:1 fade` fades the box grouping's background band; `highlight loop:1 outline`
      outlines the block frame. Assert through `render()` against `data-siren-id`.
- [x] A repeat message pair is addressable by its `#2` id.
- [x] An id no element holds is still the `references unknown id` error, at the same seam.
- [x] A block's divider lines and a box's label animate with their parent if and only if they are
      inside the tagged group — assert whichever is true of the current renderer rather than
      changing the renderer to suit the test.

## Test seam

`buildSequenceModel` for the id set, `render()` for the DOM claim.

## Write ownership

- `packages/core/src/graph-model/buildSequenceModel.ts` + `.test.ts`
- `packages/core/src/index.test.ts`

No `contracts.ts` change — this ticket widens a set, it does not add a type.

## Shared resources

None — runs alone in its round.

## Blocked by

- **03** — there is no pipeline to widen until it lands.
